estimand: out-of-sample, regime-conditioned, cross-sectional association between a funding feature and NEXT-HOUR observed liquidation intensity, tested for GENERALIZATION from the 15-coin combined metpie+ironflow panel (FCLR-XSEC-004/005/006, promotable=false) to the full on-disk ironflow_bulk 342+ coin liquidation universe. This is a cross-sectional/ordering claim, NOT a time-series forecast gate; reported as such, never as an observed-liquidation forecast gate pass.

label_construct.description: per-coin per-hour observed liquidation intensity = event count and notional_usd sum from ironflow_bulk/liquidations (columns: timestamp[ms], market, coin, position_side, size, notional_usd, avg_price, ...). Long/short sides kept separate. Absence from this capped-sample feed is NOT zero; claims restricted to presence/intensity ordering.

universe.note: Do NOT restrict to the 15-coin combined panel; do NOT substitute present-day survivors for the historical universe; report per-coin coverage and exited/survivor split.

features.primary_feature: signed funding rate (latest observation available by origin hour t, retaining sign separately)
features.normalization: train-only means and standard deviations; no full-sample quantiles

regime_variable.description: the SAME regime conditioning that produced the SUPPORTED narrow-universe findings — RV-tercile (low/mid/high) AND UTC-session bucket (Asian/European/US)
regime_variable.threshold_method: EXPANDING train-only thresholds; no future information leaks into the regime label

metrics.contrast: cross-sectional ordering of predicted vs realized next-hour intensity across coins within each test block

per_coin_block_bootstrap.method: resample complete UTC time blocks jointly across coins

leave_one_instrument_out.pass_threshold: >= 6 of 8 subsets reproduce the narrow-universe sign/direction

placebo_permutation_null.method: permute the funding feature within each test block
placebo_permutation_null.credibility_rule: the true effect must exceed the 95th percentile of the null to be credible

materiality_floor.threshold: frozen pre-specified effect size; narrow-universe sign/direction must be reproduced at broad breadth
materiality_floor.note: The primary question is GENERALIZATION, not a new threshold to shop.

verdict_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED (null preserved honestly; broad-universe failure to generalize is itself the durable finding)

input_hash_assertions.panel_hash_method: sha256 of concatenated path|sha256|rows across all 72 ironflow_bulk parquet files (dataset|month sorted)
